traceability.notes: All requirements and acceptance criteria for Story 002.0-DEV-ESLINT-CONFIG are implemented and verified. The plugin exposes recommended and strict flat-config presets (configs.recommended/strict) that define rule severities only and are intended to be spread after a plugins registration block. Config behavior is exercised via FlatESLint-based tests that confirm rules are enabled as documented. Rule schemas support configurable options (including customizable story paths) and enforce validation with clear error messages, confirmed by configuration validation tests. Comprehensive user documentation (README and ESLint 9 setup guide) provides setup instructions, examples for JS/TS/mixed/monorepo projects, and troubleshooting guidance. Targeted Jest tests for ESLint configuration and presets pass, confirming that the configuration system behaves as specified. Therefore, this story is fully implemented.
